Ubs Oconnor Has Trimmed Its Position in Bhp Bill (BBL) as Stock Value Declined; Suntrust Banks Has Increased Lockheed Martin (LMT) Stake by $2.48 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Suntrust Banks Inc increased its stake in Lockheed Martin Corp (LMT) by 11.01% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suntrust Banks Inc bought 7,735 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.55% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 77,979 shares of the military and government and technical company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $25.03 million, up from 70,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suntrust Banks Inc who had been investing in Lockheed Martin Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $92.40B market cap company. The stock increased 0.98% or $3.15 during the last trading session, reaching $323.6. About 272,801 shares traded. Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) has risen 26.83% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 15.28% the S&P500.
Ubs Oconnor Llc decreased its stake in Bhp Bill (BBL) by 19.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ubs Oconnor Llc sold 39,865 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.36% with the market. The hedge fund held 165,876 shares of the coal mining company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.69B, down from 205,741 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ubs Oconnor Llc who had been investing in Bhp Bill for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $126.03 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.25% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $47.16. About 658,430 shares traded. BHP Billiton plc (NYSE:BBL) has risen 28.11% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.56% the S&P500.
Ubs Oconnor Llc, which manages about $12.67B and $3308.68 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple In (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,013 shares to 24,713 shares, valued at $4.18 billion in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Intel Co by 49.00M shares in the quarter, for a total of 79.00M shares, and has risen its stake in Micron T (Prn).
